verdict.line: You lose if you let Darius stack 4-5 Hemorrhage and land his all-in before level 6; you win if you poke from outside his 535-range Apprehend and out-sustain him with Rylai's/Riftmaker from level 9 on.

brief.thesis: This is a cooldown-tempo fight, not a stat-check: Darius's Hemorrhage bleed and short early Decimate/Crippling Strike cooldowns give him faster trade pressure through level 5, while Mordekaiser's longer-range Q/E combo and W's shield-to-heal take over once items land. The 51% head-to-head over 3282 games reflects a genuinely even lane decided by who manages engage range and all-in timing better, not a favored side.

theirWindow.when: Darius has 4-5 Hemorrhage stacks and R up
theirWindow.what: He's about to all-in for the kill — Noxian Guillotine deals true damage scaled by your stack count and refreshes its cooldown on a kill, so disengage, pop W's stored shield, or Flash away instead of trading further.

yourWindow.when: You've landed Q and E on him
yourWindow.what: That's 2 of the 3 hits Darkness Rise needs; land one more spell or auto to trigger the damage aura and move speed buff, then press the trade and consume W's shield to heal off the damage you've stored.

start.why: The most-picked start in this matchup (76.5% pick, 52.3% WR over 3186 games); the mana and sustain let you spam Q (range 675) and E (range 700) pokes without running dry against his melee-range pressure.

boots.why: 82.9% pick rate and the top-performing boots here (51% WR over 3279 games); flat auto-attack damage reduction directly slows how fast he stacks Hemorrhage on you.

core.why: First item in the strongest recorded path (60.2% WR, 10.9% pick); the slow on your Q/E lets you kite out of his 535-range Apprehend after you pull him in with E.
Omnivamp sustains you through extended trades and stacks with W's shield-to-heal, letting you win the attrition war his bleed is built to start.
Damage-over-time on top of his own bleed punishes him for staying in your Q/E range, and it's the third item in the best-performing path (60.2% WR).

situational.when: he is fed or threatening to one-shot you with a stacked Noxian Guillotine
his Decimate heal from landing the blade edge on you is keeping him in lane
the game goes long and you need the extra utility over a fourth damage item

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks over repeated Q/E trades and grants healing on stacks, directly offsetting his Hemorrhage bleed and Decimate sustain in extended fights.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the most-picked (84.8%) and highest win-rate (50.9%) combo in this matchup; Ignite punishes his all-in since Darius has no dash or escape once he's hooked you with E or leapt with R, and Flash lets you dodge Apprehend or a lethal Guillotine when low.

playing.title: Poke from outside his Apprehend
playing.detail: Your Q (range 675) and E (range 700) both outrange his E hook (range 535); throw Q from max range before level 6 instead of letting him walk Decimate/Crippling Strike onto you.

playing.title: Chain Q into E for Darkness Rise
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after 3 landed attacks or spells on champions; pairing Q then E (or an auto) in one trade procs the damage aura and move speed buff mid-fight.

playing.title: Disengage before his 5th stack
playing.detail: Hemorrhage enrages Darius with massive bonus AD once he hits max stacks on you — break off the trade once he's at 4, don't let him complete the stack.

playing.title: Time your W shield to his burst
playing.detail: Indestructible stores the damage you deal and take into a shield; pop it right as he commits his Q/W combo or leaps in with R so you survive the burst, then consume it to heal.

playing.title: Save R to isolate, not just to fight
playing.detail: Realm of Death removes his jungler and allies from the fight entirely — hold it for when his jungler is elsewhere on the map so you get a clean 1v1 rather than using it reactively.

playing.title: Buy armor early if he's ahead
playing.detail: Plated Steelcaps plus Bramble Vest/Thornmail cut his physical damage and the healing from his bleed stacks, matching OP.GG's own read on this matchup.

playing.title: Don't feed him free E pulls
playing.detail: His Apprehend passively shreds a percentage of your armor on hit and the active pulls you to him from 535 range — hold your spacing until you've decided to commit to the trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and win-rate numbers are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch (16.19.1, 3282 games); the mechanical reasoning — cooldown windows, stack thresholds, and trade timing — is my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Purchases foremost Plated Steelcamps, Bramble Vest, and other items with armor. Maintain your distance from Darius’s (E) especially if he has Ghost.
